messages.text:
I ordered a Bitfortun BS-2, and it seems that the heat sync was not installed properly.  
After running for a bit of tome I get VREG Overheated on the display.
I looked at the heat sync, and it is not installed correctly (it is installed at Elmore 90 degrees, and it seems glued on).  Photos can be seen here: ····

Sorry, that's not how it should have left the factory. Power it down for now, a VREG running hot like that can damage the board.

That's an RMA. Fill this in and you'll get a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform — add your photos there, they help a lot. Processing takes up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse.

One thing I have to ask, since overclocked or modified units aren't covered: has it been run at stock settings?
Stock settings and it was turned off when that occurred

Good, then you're covered. Stock settings, factory assembly fault, that's on us.

Send the RMA form with those photos and you'll get the label. Don't power it back up in the meantime.

What's your order number? I'll flag it to the team so they're watching for your RMA when it lands and can move it along.
ok I've submitted the RMA form

Nice, that's the main step done. The return label comes by email, so keep an eye on your inbox and spam.

Can you give me your order number? With that I'll flag it to the team so they track your RMA through and it doesn't sit in the queue.
Got it. What's the email on the order? I need it to pull Shop···· up and tag the RMA to it.
Handed to the team · factory assembly fault, needs JD to look at the photos and push the RMA/label th

Pulled it up, both BS-2s delivered September 20. I've flagged your RMA with the photos and the note that the heatsink came glued on rotated, at stock settings. JD on our team will pick it up here, so stay in the chat if you can, and if you step away you'll get it by email.

One thing, you had two units on that order. Is the second one running fine, or is it doing the same?
